decoder: assets/swipe/ctc_swipe.onnx, Kotlin lexicon beam width 120, 60,564-word dictionary
method: GlideDecodeLatencyTest, synthetic traces through the key centers, 5 warm-up runs, 30 measured runs; median of three runs
notes: Cold start covers ONNX session creation and the 60,564-word trie build; it runs off the main thread on subtype load.
Debug builds and a flagship SoC: mid-range phones will be slower, so treat these as a lower bound.
Decode time grows roughly linearly with word length (~4.5 ms per letter).
An earlier run on 2026-11-11 measured about 1.85x slower (cold 473 ms; p50 15.8 / 32.9 / 66.4 ms), most likely thermal throttling. The stable 2026-11-12 runs are recorded here.
